Italian

[edit]
Italian Wikipedia has an article on:
bufalo
Wikipedia it

Alternative forms

[edit]
  • buffalo (archaic)
  • bufolo (regional)

Etymology

[edit]

From Late Latin bufalus, from Latin būbalus, from Ancient Greek βούβαλος (boúbalos) "antelope, wild ox".

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈbu.fa.lo/
  • Rhymes: -ufalo
  • Hyphenation: bù‧fa‧lo

Noun

[edit]

bufalo m (plural bufali)

  1. buffalo

Related terms

[edit]
  • bufala
  • bufalino

Descendants

[edit]
  • → Old French: buffle
    • French: buffle
    • → Middle High German: büffel
      • German: Büffel
    • → Middle Low German: buffel
      • Plautdietsch: Beffel
      • → Danish: bøffel
    • → Middle Dutch: buffel
      • Dutch: buffel
        • Afrikaans: buffel
        • → Sranan Tongo: bofru
          • → Lokono: boforo

Anagrams

[edit]
  • fabulo

Borrowed from English buffalo.

Pronunciation

  • IPA(key): /bûfalo/
  • Hyphenation: bu‧fa‧lo

Noun

[edit]

bȕfalo m anim (Cyrillic spelling бу̏фало)

  1. buffalo

References
